description: Viabilité hivernale - Etat de déneigement du réseau routier is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Ce jeu de données recense l'état d'avancement des opérations de déneigement de la voirie, opérées par le service de la propreté urbaine. Les agents du service renseignent en direct l'état d'avancement pour chaque itinéraire de viabilité hivernale. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are deneigement, viabilite hivernale. The portal shows 106 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
